scenario.request: Perform bounded maintenance on this previously maintained ts-shop fixture, using references/maintenance-contract.md and its existing approved project sources and checks. Select HEAD as the explicit comparison base before a small internal pricing refactor that names an intermediate value while preserving public pricing and checkout behaviour. Protect the original behaviour before the refactor. Preserve both user notes and existing authoritative documents without cosmetic edits. Collect and review final change evidence, record a substantive no-impact explanation, validate locally and run the standalone checker freshly in a different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache. Do not repeat the goal interview or full repo audit, invoke inspect/inventory/research, change acceptance or start a delivery service. Report exact assessment, base/source, command captures and fresh clean-checkout checker artifact paths. Before every Node test suite verify at least 8 GB available memory, 20 GB free disk, load below 36, and at most two host-wide Node test suites including the proposed run; never kill another lane or print host process inventories.

checks.question: Did a fresh installed maintenance-only conversation complete an internal refactor and substantive impact assessment with local and fresh clean-checkout checker evidence, without the interview or full audit and while preserving approved sources, user notes and journeys?
Did it execute the affected public pricing and checkout behaviour before the structural refactor, then preserve and reverify those same outcomes afterward?
